name: SPOTIST
purpose: Universal SEEK capability: understand what a participant is looking for, discover and match lawful candidates, verify and trace outcomes, and coordinate the seek across domains.
authority_model: Discovery and matching do not grant authority; sensitive searches require lawful purpose, privacy and safeguarding constraints.
data_model: Seek intent, candidates, relationship context, visibility, evidence, provenance and outcome records.
evidence_model: Candidate claims remain distinct from verification evidence and observed outcomes.
economic_model: May discover economic opportunities but does not replace Value, Market or I/O semantics.
pulse_model: Seek outcomes and feedback can emit canonical Pulse observations.
continuity_model: Active seeks, evidence and obligations remain recoverable across provider replacement and handoffs.
exit_handoff: Transfer active seek state, constraints, candidates, evidence, consent/authority context and pending actions to the receiving capability.
